lines.zh: 我从深板岩缝里钻出来，慢慢走。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a deepslate crack and walk.

lines.zh: 我的脚步把粉尘抖在地上。
lines.en: My steps shake dust onto the floor.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边掉下细灰。
lines.en: As I walk, fine ash falls off me.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，那东西会毁了我。
lines.en: I skirt the puddle; it would ruin me.
I shuffle along, keeping very close.
Every ten paces I pause.

lines.zh: 洞里的石头被我磨得发亮。
lines.en: The tunnel stone is polished by my passing.
I slowly work my way behind you.
I'm slow, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 我身上抖落的粉，会粘住东西。
lines.en: The dust I shed sticks to things.
I walk in the dark without blinking.

lines.zh: 我一步深一步浅，像喝醉了。
lines.en: My steps wander, as if drunk.

lines.zh: 我踩过自己的灰，留下痕。
lines.en: I tread through my own ash and leave a trail.
I follow the mine supports.

lines.zh: 我挪到通风口下，躲一躲。
lines.en: I shift under the vent to hide.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，可我的呼吸很响。
lines.en: My steps are soft; my breathing is not.

lines.zh: 我站在石头后面，慢慢充能。
lines.en: I stand behind the stone, slowly charging.
My countdown keeps running.
I stare at the ground, counting something.
No water here. I'm comfortable.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖肩膀，灰落下来。
lines.en: I shrug, and ash falls.
My fingers count the seconds.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的滴水声，讨厌。
lines.en: I hear a distant drip. I hate it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢呼出一口灰色的气。
lines.en: I breathe out a grey cloud.
I'm deciding when to burst.
The cave is quiet. I like that.
I press myself against the cold stone.
My dust glows, faintly.

lines.zh: 有只蝙蝠飞过，我没理它。
lines.en: A bat flits by; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖一直没停过抖。
lines.en: My knees never stop trembling.
Dust applied; twenty seconds to the blast.
This place is far from water.
You're so clean. How nice.
I sprinkled a little dust on you.
Do you smell something?
Twenty seconds left. I'm counting.
Don't brush at it; it won't come off.
We're close. That's convenient.
Look at my hands. They keep shaking.

lines.zh: 你身上有水的味道，退后。
lines.en: You smell of water. Stay back.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，粉尘往下掉。
lines.en: When I smile, dust falls.
You run fast, but the dust follows.
I'm waiting for a certain bang.
I've memorized your face.
My ash is scattered.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的倒数乱了两秒。
lines.en: That jumbled my countdown by two seconds.
A piece came off, still smoking dust.
I retreat and press to the wall.
My chest caved in.
My breathing rasps like a bellows.
Dust all over the floor. Wasteful.
I can't stand steady; I hold the rock.
Now I'll have to charge again.
Not too hard; I still want to burst.
That little flame, I rather want it.
Warm things charge me faster.

lines.zh: 你把火把举近，我就过去了。
lines.en: Raise the torch and I'll come over.
I ease closer so as not to scare you.
Your breath is warm.

lines.zh: 那点火星，让我浑身发痒。
lines.en: Those sparks make me itch all over.
My outstretched hand stops in midair.
Don't go far; I can't keep up.
This distance suits me.

lines.zh: 我把粉慢慢往你那边吹。
lines.en: I blow my dust slowly toward you.
A little closer and I'll have enough time.
I smell sulfur. Good.

lines.zh: 你把火收起来，我就停下。
lines.en: Put the fire away and I'll stop.
That warmth makes me unable to move on.

lines.zh: 我的倒计时忽然快了一点。
lines.en: My countdown suddenly quickens.
I lean in; don't move.
You bump me and get dust on you.

lines.zh: 我退开一步，粉也跟着散。
lines.en: I step back and the dust scatters too.
I brush your cuff and leave a mark.
Don't shove; I'm unsteady.
We collide and ash puffs out.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的手，我抽了一下。
lines.en: You step on my hand and I jerk it back.

lines.zh: 我侧身让，粉掉在你鞋上。
lines.en: I turn aside, and dust falls on your boot.
That knock sped up my countdown.

lines.zh: 我扶了墙一下，墙都黑了。
lines.en: I catch the wall and it blackens.

lines.zh: 我们离得太近，你要糟了。
lines.en: Too close; you're in trouble.
Another climbs out of the crack.

lines.zh: 我们互相撒粉，算是问好。
lines.en: We dust each other by way of greeting.

lines.zh: 它的倒计时和我的差不多。
lines.en: Its countdown runs about like mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，一起充能。
lines.en: We stand side by side, charging together.
Two clouds of ash drift in the cave.

lines.zh: 它把一部分粉分给了我。
lines.en: It shares some of its dust with me.
We count the twenty seconds together.
Its hands shake too.
We stand close; it'll be loud.
Only the two of us remain in the cave.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块深板岩，收好。
lines.en: I pick up a piece of deepslate.
I keep this torch for later.
I wrap it in ash.
A bit of iron; I pick it up.
It touches my dust and blackens.
This one goes into a hole for safekeeping.
This will be useful later.
I carry it carefully.
Whatever falls to the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 这块煤我收进灰里，留着充能。
lines.en: I tuck this coal into the ash for later charging.
The dust is already on you.

lines.zh: 粉尘已经落在你的护肩上。
lines.en: The dust has already settled on your shoulder guard.
I've started counting down.
Twenty seconds; neither of us need rush.
That dust on you is warming.
I back away slowly. Not from fear.
You're brushing at it. Useless.

lines.zh: 二十秒够我退到石柱后。
lines.en: Twenty seconds is plenty for me to slip behind the pillar.
This time I've timed it right.
I smile and dust falls.
I follow you, and the dust follows.
Fifteen seconds; I can get closer.
I don't need to touch you; the dust is enough.
Under the flagstone, I wait for your step.

lines.zh: 粉尘贴在你的靴跟上，等它响。
lines.en: The dust clings to your heel, waiting to go off.
I stop at ten.
You back to the wall, and the dust arrives.
I'm holding it in. Holding it well.
The tunnel grows hotter.
Can you hear me breathe?
Ash gets in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我把你按在墙上，粉沾满了。
lines.en: I pin you to the wall, and the dust takes hold.
I step back and start counting.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领口，不松手。
lines.en: I grip your collar and don't let go.

lines.zh: 粉尘从我的指缝漏下去。
lines.en: Dust sifts between my fingers.

lines.zh: 这一下，省了我不少时间。
lines.en: That saved me a lot of time.
The more you struggle, the more it clings.
I push you toward the rubble.

lines.zh: 我的手在你背上留下印子。
lines.en: My hand leaves a print on your back.
I lean to your ear and count to three.
The deepslate splits and I crawl out.

lines.zh: 洞里忽然多了一股灰味。
lines.en: A smell of ash fills the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我从诱导石里慢慢成形。
lines.en: I take shape slowly from the lure stone.

lines.zh: 地上的灰自己聚了起来。
lines.en: The ash on the floor gathers by itself.

lines.zh: 我的倒计时从二十开始。
lines.en: My countdown begins at twenty.
Someone coughs deep in the mine.

lines.zh: 深板岩缝里冒出灰，我先吸气。
lines.en: Ash rises from the deepslate crack; I breathe in first.
This level of the cave suddenly warms.
A shadow joins the wall.
I stand up slowly, loudly.

lines.zh: 火点着了我的粉，一路烧上来。
lines.en: Fire lights my dust and runs up me.

lines.zh: 我从石阶上滚下来，粉撒了一路。
lines.en: I tumble down the steps, dust trailing.
Water! My charge is gone.

lines.zh: 爆风吹散了我一半的身子。
lines.en: The blast scatters half of me.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我，灰从洞里漏。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and dust leaks out.

lines.zh: 法术把我的粉都凝住了。
lines.en: That spell sets all my dust solid.
Too long without charging; I'm coming apart.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我身上的粉全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all my dust lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空把灰吸走了，连我一起。
lines.en: The void draws off the ash, and me with it.
